def basis(p, scale, form):
    if form == 'constant':
        return p[:, :1]
    d = p[:, 3] / scale
    e = 1 / (1 + d * d) if form == 'rational' else np.exp(-d)
    x = np.column_stack((p[:, :3], e))
    return np.column_stack((x, e[:, None] * p[:, 1:3])) if form == 'interaction' else x
